stem: A student mixes a sample of stones with a sample of table salt. The mass and volume of the samples were determined before mixing the samples. The mass and volume of each sample is shown.
instruction: Which statement is true about the mixture?

options.label: F
options.text: The mass of the mixture is 85 grams.

options.label: G
options.text: The mass of the mixture is 60 milliliters.

options.label: H
options.text: The volume of the mixture is 60 grams.

options.label: J
options.text: The volume of the mixture is 85 milliliters.

visual_elements: table with Material, Grams (g), Milliliters (mL) columns; rows: Stones 45 25, Salt 40 35
